items.name: 仰卧主动直腿抬高功能观察
items.phase_zh: 仰卧、双腿伸展、身体与双脚自然放稳。
items.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Edit target: image 1 is action 010 E-LOW-005 s01, a supine straight-leg raise preparation photo. Images 2-4 are same woman identity/style references.
Make one precise visibility correction to image 1, retaining same 1536x1024 wide landscape framing and LOW SIDE camera, identical face, black ponytail, plain white short sleeve shirt, charcoal trousers and white shoes, gray-blue studio, mat, lighting, body scale, and exact head/torso/pelvis/leg/foot positions.
KEEP BOTH legs straight resting on mat and knees extended, both heels supported, head/upper back/pelvis on mat. KEEP near-camera arm extended on mat at body side, visible hand in same position.
Change only the FAR arm that is currently hidden behind torso: bend its elbow naturally and rest its entire FAR hand gently palm-down on the upper abdomen over the white T-shirt, around the lower ribs, with all five fingers naturally visible above body from this same low side camera. The bent forearm naturally crosses onto abdomen and connects to her far shoulder, exactly two arms total. This hand is relaxed and does not hold, press, touch or assist either leg. This is a neutral resting-arm setup, no sit-up or torso rotation. Near arm/hand remains on mat. Both FULL hands now identifiable, no extra hand or fingers.
Nothing else moves. Do not alter legs, feet, face, body position, camera, mat or background. ONE woman, ONE preparation pose, single realistic unlabelled photograph, no collage, text, numbers, arrows, watermark or logos.

QA.observations: 实际看图：双腿伸展，双脚跟接垫，头肩与骨盆留垫；近手落垫、远手自然轻放上腹，完整双手可辨，均不接触或辅助腿。全头双足完整、比例自然，人物/衣着/灰蓝棚拍风格一致。

items.prompt_initial:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one independent photorealistic rehabilitation step demonstration photograph.
Input images: images 1-3 are strict identity, clothing, photographic quality, light and gray-blue background references, not exercise pose instructions.
Subject: EXACT SAME East Asian adult woman as all 3 references, same face, age, skin tone, body build and black ponytail; plain white short sleeve crewneck T-shirt, dark charcoal full length trousers; plain white unbranded low-profile thin-soled sneakers.
Scene: cool muted gray-blue seamless studio floor/backdrop, soft diffuse neutral studio light, natural soft shadows. A single thin dark charcoal nonslip exercise mat on the flat floor.
Composition: wide landscape 3:2 single camera, normal 50mm perspective, low true side view with a very slight view from foot/front side to distinguish the two legs without foreshortening. Her head is at image LEFT and feet at image RIGHT. Whole body occupies roughly 80% of image width. Include full head, both hands, both complete shoes, entire mat with small comfortable margins. Camera about 45 cm above mat, horizontal lens and stable floor datum. No pillow, bed, chair, straps or medical equipment. Normal adult human proportions and continuous joints, exactly two arms/two legs, correct hands.
Action 010 E-LOW-005 supine active straight-leg raise, basic assessment version with NON-TEST LEG STRAIGHT along the mat.
Step 01 ONLY: she lies relaxed on her back, head, shoulders and pelvis resting on the mat. Both legs extended straight side by side and supported on the mat, knees comfortably straight. Both heels touch mat, toes point naturally slightly upwards. Arms relaxed long at her sides with both hands resting on mat. Show both feet distinctly, feet separated a little laterally (anatomical hip-width), no one leg stacked over other. Calm neutral face looking upwards, head and neck supported naturally.
Constraints: a SINGLE clean photo, ONE person, ONE pose, no montage, inset, mirror, motion ghosts, arrows, number, text, labels, logos or watermark. Leave modest empty gray-blue space above body. Preserve identity/style of references.

items.name: 仰卧主动直腿抬高功能观察
items.phase_zh: 主动抬起近相机側直腿，膝保持伸展，非测试腿继续伸直留垫。
items.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Image 1 is action 010 E-LOW-005 STEP 01 with corrected visible far hand, the exact scene and continuity reference. Image 2 is the previously generated STEP 02 pose reference ONLY. Image 3 is identity/style reference.
Generate a separate STEP 02 photograph from image 1. Preserve image 1's exact woman, face/ponytail/clothing/shoes, LOW SIDE horizontal 3:2 camera, frame and person scale, gray-blue studio and thin dark gray mat, light, head, neck, shoulders, torso and pelvis positions. Keep the near arm straight along mat and full hand resting on mat. Keep the FAR elbow bent and FAR full hand relaxed palm-down on upper abdomen in EXACT image-1 position; fingers visible, hand never assists leg.
CHANGE ONLY the NEAR CAMERA LEG: rotate this whole straight leg from the hip upwards to approximately the same comfortable 30-40 degree raise shown in image 2. Keep its knee extended, continuous natural thigh/knee/shin/ankle proportions and original relaxed ankle/shoe. Full lifted shoe visible in upper right. FAR LEG stays straight along mat as in image 1, FAR heel on mat, FAR shoe at EXACT image-1 coordinates and shoe angle. Do not swap legs or slide the non-test foot sideways or forward. Pelvis remains flat on mat, no bridge, no extra lumbar arch, no head raise.
The one change is active straight-leg raising. Keep both complete hands and both feet visible. ONE woman, ONE pose, single realistic raw photo. No text, numbered steps, arrows, logos, watermarks, montage, inset, ghosts or additional objects.

QA.observations: 实际看图：近侧测试腿保持膝伸展整体抬起，非测试腿伸展留垫、脚跟接垫，头肩与骨盆留垫；近手落垫、远手轻放上腹，两帧手位一致且不辅助腿。机位/垫位/躯干尺度一致，非测试鞋有轻微生成位置偏差而非改变腿位版本；双手/全头/双足可辨、比例自然。

items.prompt_initial:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one independent photorealistic rehabilitation step demonstration photo.
Image 1 is the exact composition/base frame for action 010 E-LOW-005 step 01. Images 2-4 are identity/clothing/gray-blue studio references.
Create STEP 02 for the same straight-leg raise. Preserve the exact woman, face, body build, black ponytail, white short sleeve shirt, dark charcoal long trousers, white unbranded thin-soled shoes. Preserve identical head-left/feet-right position, horizontal landscape 3:2 camera/framing/perspective/person scale, thin dark gray mat, gray-blue seamless studio, light, natural shadows. Head, upper back, pelvis, both arms and resting hands remain on mat in their EXACT positions. Head and neck remain relaxed, supported, no sit-up.
CHANGE ONLY the near-camera leg: actively lift this whole leg from the hip approximately 40 degrees above the mat, maintaining the knee comfortably straight in its original extended alignment. The thigh, knee, shin, ankle form one continuous naturally proportioned long straight leg with foot relaxed, no knee bend. Raise the foot towards the upper right of the frame, full shoe visible. The FAR leg remains fully EXTENDED, straight and flat on mat in its EXACT original position and far heel remains in contact with mat. Clearly separate lifted near leg from far grounded leg so both knees and both shoes can be seen. No belt, hands pulling leg, straps or external aid. Pelvis stays level, resting on mat, no bridge or lumbar arch.
A single woman in one pose, full head/hands/both shoes retained, anatomically correct normal adult thigh/calf lengths and feet, no extra limbs. No montage, text, arrow, numbers, logo, watermark or inset. Keep generous gray-blue empty space above.

revision_note: 交叉检查后修订远侧手可见性：远手轻放上腹，近手留垫；原卡未限定手位，两帧手位统一、均不辅助腿部。原始版本保留，最终选用_v2。
